# Variable `SPDX_NAMESPACE_PREFIX`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

This option could be used in order to change the prefix of `spdxDocument` and the prefix of `documentNamespace`. It is set by default to `http://spdx.org/spdxdoc`.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SPDX_NAMESPACE_PREFIX
